description: Typical US home value from the Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI, Zillow Research's official public data: mid-tier homes, single-family + condo, smoothed, seasonally adjusted, USD) for states or metro areas: latest monthly value, change vs 12 months earlier and monthly history (back to 2000) for every region whose name matches (up to 10). Index data, not individual listings or Zestimates (zillow.com pages block automated access). Updated monthly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

level.description: state (default) or metro (metro file includes the United States row)

months.description: How many recent monthly values per region, 1-320 (default 12)

region.description: Region name or part of it, e.g. 'Texas', 'Austin, TX', 'United States' (required)

name: realestate_zillow
title: Realestate Zillow
